methodology.observation_window_basis: Window starts at the previous successful canonical run window_end and ends at the current pre-schedule observation cutoff; the weekend is included because no successful immutable run exists for 2026-09-25.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing difficult-to-reverse commercialization, deployment, manufacturing, infrastructure, regulatory, and technical milestones.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution sources; use an originating-company press release distributed by a reputable publisher when a direct primary page is not available.
methodology.repeat_policy: Canonical event fingerprints were checked; repeated events are included only for material updates with preserved event_key and material_update_from.
excluded_noise: market-price movement without underlying technical or commercial change

provenance.notes: Immutable-ledger-only persistence; legacy history and visual artifacts were not read or rewritten.

findings.headline: SpaceX Starship reaches orbit for the first time and deploys Starlink V3 satellites
findings.summary: On Flight 14, Starship reached Earth orbit for the first time after 13 integrated flights that used suborbital trajectories. The mission also deployed the first batch of Starlink V3 satellites, while Super Heavy completed a controlled Gulf splashdown.
findings.why_it_matters: Reaching orbit converts Starship from a suborbital flight-test vehicle into an orbital launch system and demonstrates the mission profile needed for operational Starlink V3 deployment.
findings.trend_statement: Reusable super-heavy launch is moving from suborbital development into orbital deployment operations.

findings.headline: NVIDIA launches an open full-stack safety platform for autonomous AI agents
findings.summary: NVIDIA launched Open Agent Safety Platform, combining the OpenShell secure runtime with the Sentry reference system design. Sentry uses BlueField-4 DPUs as an out-of-band watchdog, while more than 100 organizations are participating across software, infrastructure, critical industry and robotics.
findings.why_it_matters: Agent safety is moving from application-level policy into independent infrastructure controls spanning software and silicon. Broad ecosystem participation makes this a potential deployment-layer standard rather than a single-vendor feature.
findings.trend_statement: Agentic AI infrastructure is adding independent, hardware-backed governance as autonomous systems gain access to tools, networks and physical systems.

findings.headline: Vertical Aerospace opens Valo assembly centre for certification aircraft and early production
findings.summary: Vertical Aerospace opened a dedicated 60,000-square-foot Aircraft Assembly Centre at Cotswold Airport. The facility will assemble certification-conforming Valo aircraft and a hybrid-electric demonstrator and is designed to support more than 25 aircraft annually during early production after certification.
findings.why_it_matters: The facility moves Valo from prototype development toward certification-oriented industrialization and creates physical capacity for compliance aircraft and initial customer deliveries.
findings.trend_statement: Electric aviation is progressing from prototype programs toward certification-oriented manufacturing capacity.
